name: GenerateEvaluationReport

parameters.help_en: The account ID. If you do not specify this parameter, the report is generated for the current account by default. A management account can specify the ID of member accounts to generate a report for the member accounts
parameters.help_zh: 账号ID，若不传入，默认生成当前账号的报告，MA账号可以传入成员账号的ID生成成员账号的报告
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The report type. Valid values:
EvaluationAccountHtmlReport: single-account HTML report.
EvaluationAccountExcelReport: single-account Excel report.
EvaluationMultiAccountExcelReport: multi-account Excel report
parameters.help_zh:
报告类型。取值类型：
EvaluationAccountHtmlReport：单账号HTML报告。
EvaluationAccountExcelReport：单账号EXCEL报告。
EvaluationMultiAccountExcelReport：多账号EXCEL报告
parameters.name: report_type

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the member accounts for which you want to generate reports.
Note: You need to specify this parameter only when you generate a multi-account report and want to generate the report for specific accounts
parameters.help_zh:
生成报告的成员账号ID列表。
说明：仅在您生成多账号报告时，且希望生成指定账号范围的报告，才需要传入该参数
parameters.name: account_ids

parameters.help_en:
The evaluation domain. Valid values:

CloudGovernance (default): cloud governance maturity evaluation.
AiGovernance: AI governance maturity evaluation
parameters.help_zh:
检测领域。取值：

CloudGovernance（默认）：云治理成熟度检测
AiGovernance: AI 治理成熟度检测
parameters.name: evaluation_domain

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the account for which the report is generated

Finished.description_en:
Indicates whether the report is generated.

true: The report is generated.
false: The report is not generated
Finished.description_zh:
报告是否生成完毕。

true：报告生成完毕
false：报告未生成完毕

ReportType.description_zh:
